main_measure.name: mean 7-bar forward return minus coin's grid mean, forecast > 0 grid bars, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean excess return (median forecast split)

decided_by: The main measure's t is between -2 and 2.
reading: Grid bars are positions 0, 7, 14, ... of each window with a 7-bar forward return inside the window; the coin mean is over all such grid bars of all windows; the median split puts forecast > median in the upper half and forecast <= median in the lower half; the 100-case minimum is applied as 'not observable'.
